edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, granting contract ownership to the caller.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership writes newOwner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] with the requested token amount.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller identity.
transferFrom consumes allowed[from][msg.sender], so the caller identity is the authorization subject.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender into the external receiveApproval call.
transferAnyERC20Token is gated by onlyOwner, which compares msg.sender with owner.
Constructor writes the untrusted caller address into the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner to authorize the caller before changing ownership.
transferOwnership stores the supplied parameter into newOwner.
acceptOwnership assigns owner = newOwner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
Pokemons constructor sets symbol = "PMON".
Pokemons constructor sets name = "Pokemons".
Pokemons constructor sets decimals = 18.
Pokemons constructor sets _totalSupply to 500000000000000000000.
Pokemons constructor credits the entire supply to the fixed address balances.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] in its return expression.
totalSupply performs an unchecked subtraction, allowing integer underflow if balances[address(0)] exceeds _totalSupply.
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner].
transfer writes the sender and recipient entries of the balances mapping.
transfer calls safeSub on the sender balance, propagating the arithmetic guard.
transfer calls safeAdd on the recipient balance, propagating the arithmetic guard.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom mutates balances[from] and balances[to].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom calls safeSub for both balance and allowance reductions.
transferFrom calls safeAdd for the recipient balance increase.
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
approveAndCall hands control to an attacker-supplied contract via receiveApproval after mutating allowance state.
transferAnyERC20Token transfers control to an arbitrary token contract that can re-enter or behave maliciously.
transferAnyERC20Token sends the recovered tokens to the owner address.
Parameter a feeds the addition inside safeAdd.
Parameter b feeds the addition inside safeAdd.
Local variable c is the return value computed inside safeAdd.
transfer recipient parameter is credited in balances.
transfer amount parameter drives safeSub and safeAdd.
transferFrom 'from' parameter indexes the debited balance and allowance.
transferFrom 'to' parameter indexes the credited balance.
transferFrom amount parameter drives safeSub and safeAdd.
approve spender parameter indexes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
approve amount parameter is stored into the allowance mapping.
approveAndCall spender parameter is both the allowance key and the external call target.
approveAndCall tokens parameter is stored as allowance and forwarded to the callee.
approveAndCall data parameter is forwarded verbatim into the external receiveApproval call.
transferAnyERC20Token tokenAddress parameter becomes the external call target.
transferAnyERC20Token tokens parameter is forwarded to the external transfer call.
transferOwnership stores the _newOwner parameter into the newOwner state variable.
balanceOf tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping.
allowance tokenOwner parameter indexes the outer allowed mapping.
allowance spender parameter indexes the inner allowed mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: Recipient parameter only exists to index the balances mapping inside transfer; it is subsumed by the transfer function node.
Amount parameter is consumed exclusively by safeSub/safeAdd calls inside transfer.
Source account parameter is only used to index balances and allowed inside transferFrom.
Destination account parameter is only used to index balances inside transferFrom.
Amount parameter is consumed solely by the safeSub/safeAdd arithmetic within transferFrom.
Spender parameter only keys the allowance mapping write inside approve.
Allowance amount parameter is written directly into allowed inside approve.
Spender parameter is both the allowance key and the external call target, so it collapses into approveAndCall.
Amount parameter is stored and forwarded within approveAndCall only.
Opaque calldata parameter is forwarded only inside the approveAndCall external call.
Token address parameter is the target of the unsafe external transfer call, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
Amount parameter is forwarded to the unsafe external token transfer call.
Proposed owner parameter is simply stored into newOwner inside transferOwnership.
Query parameter only indexes the balances mapping inside balanceOf.
Outer key parameter only indexes the allowed mapping inside allowance.
Inner key parameter only indexes the allowed mapping inside allowance.
Arithmetic operand a is only used inside safeAdd.
Arithmetic operand b is only used inside safeAdd.
Local result c is the return value computed entirely inside safeAdd.
